title: Progress bar not showing in tile during download
deepseek-coder-7b-instruct-q5-k-m shows as missing and download button in tile is non-functional
description:
Fixed both issues:

1. **deepseek-coder-7b-instruct-q5-k-m shows as missing**: Updated models.json to set file_exists=false for this model since the actual file doesn't exist.

2. **Download button in tile is non-functional**: Fixed the search term extraction in api_download_search_filename endpoint. The code now properly strips quantization suffixes (like Q5_K_M) from the search term before querying HuggingFace.

Changes made:
- /mnt/c/llama.cpp/models.json: Set file_exists=false for deepseek-coder-7b-instruct-q5-k-m
- /mnt/c/llama.cpp/web/app.py: Fixed search_term extraction to strip quantization suffix

The download button should now work correctly for missing models.

description: IMPLEMENTED: Progress bars are now stored in downloadProgressState object and rendered as part of tile HTML during refresh(). Changes: 1) Added downloadProgressState = {} object to store progress state, 2) Modified refresh() to render progress bars inside tiles using stored state, 3) Modified showProgressBar() to initialize state instead of creating DOM elements, 4) Modified SSE listener to update both DOM elements AND stored state, 5) Used consistent ID sanitization for element IDs, 6) Added XSS sanitization for progress details text. Result: Progress bars persist across refreshes without visual flicker.

title: Progress bar initially displays within tile then disappears
description: Progress bar is appended to tile by showProgressBar() but disappears when refresh() re-renders all tiles. The innerHTML replacement wipes out dynamically added progress bars. Fix options: track active downloads and re-inject progress bars after render, or prevent tile replacement for tiles with active downloads.
